name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateStopTransition
summary: Per-frame step of the jackpot screen's stop sequence: advances the transition at +0x1A8, starts the cue at +0x1D4 once the counter at +0x1BC reaches 0x37 (with a colour chosen by whether the u16 at +0xE0 is 0x3C), and when the transition state at +0x1AC equals 0x004457BC and +0x1B0 is 0, commits the pending control and copies two floats from the global 0x0072AA0C+0x88 into +0x50.
evidence: NEW: the asm at 0x002C8750 shows bl 0x445BF0(self+0x1A8), the 0x37 counter test, bl 0x284CA0 (Ui_Cue_Start) with the 0x3C comparison as its bool argument, and the 0x004457BC/0x1B0 test before Ui_Screen_CommitPendingControl plus a two-float copy from 0x0072AA0C+0x88. That is a per-frame update, not a predicate, so the old 'CheckStop' wording was wrong; the class is well supported by the confident Ui_JackpotScreen_* siblings, but what the 0x37 counter and the 0x004457BC sentinel mean is still open.

name: maybe_Actor_Action_Move_UpdateAnimation
summary: Per-frame driver of a move action: adds the frame delta to the clock at +0x34, bumps the frame counter at +0x38 and dispatches the current step of the four-entry 0x18-byte table at +0x2C.
evidence: The body is a generic step-table runner (identical in shape to 0x002B1100 and to the frame-script driver 0x00261F40) and the float argument arrives in s0, which Ghidra shows as in_s0; no caller and no named callee pin the action type, so 'Move' and 'Animation' remain guesses.

name: maybe_Field_Action_DtorDeleteB
summary: Deleting destructor of a field-action variant: runs the shared base destructor 0x00193E44 and then frees the object with operator delete (0x0010F6CC).
evidence: The base destructor 0x00193E44 is still unnamed and the body is a two-call stub, so only the 'deleting destructor of some field-action variant' reading is supported (vtable row 0x0075FD9C sits next to the confident Field_ActorAction_PlayStateAnim and maybe_Field_Action_UpdateAnim). Which variant it is cannot be told from the body.

name: maybe_Field_Action_DtorDeleteC

evidence: 0x00294C88 is the shared base-destructor body also used by the Pitfall and Nut action variants, so the family is supported, but the concrete class of vtable row 0x0075FDD4 is only inferable from unnamed neighbours (0x002C0A34/0x002C0A50/0x00294C2C).

evidence: Vtable row 0x0075FE3C sits next to the confident Field_ActorAction_UpdateTurnDirection and 0x00414570/0x004143FC, so the family is a field actor-action, but the base destructor 0x00193E44 is unnamed and the body is a two-call stub, so the concrete variant is not identifiable.

name: maybe_Field_Action_Nut_DtorDelete
summary: Deleting destructor of the nut action: runs the shared base destructor 0x00193E44 and then frees the object with operator delete (0x0010F6CC).
evidence: The whole vtable (row 0x0075FEA4, siblings maybe_Field_Action_Nut_Begin, maybe_Field_Action_Nut_UpdateTimer, maybe_Field_Action_Nut_Update, 0x002C1254) and the confident Field_Action_UpdateNutState use 'Nut', so the class wording is right, but every sibling is still maybe_ and the base destructor 0x00193E44 is unnamed, so the prefix stays.

name: maybe_Gfx_Node_FinishTextureLoad
summary: Completes a pending asynchronous load on a Gfx node: when the pending owner at +0x160 matches, it notifies the node through slot +0x74 (finished flag 0 or 1) and, for mode bytes 3/4, resets the three sub-resources of the loaded object.
evidence: The 'texture' part is unverified: 0x00633EA0 is only ldr r0,[r0,#0x4f0] (a getter) and is also used by 0x002C19E4 as an animation-start helper. Verified are the owner match at +0x160, the 3/4 mode bytes at +0x228 and the three 0x003BF3xx resets; no caller and no named callee identify the resource kind.

name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_DtorDelete
summary: Second compiled copy of the Gfx scene-node deleting destructor: releases the node's child tree through 0x005F8528 (inside Field_SceneObject_Delete) and frees the object with operator delete (0x0010F6CC).
evidence: A confident Gfx_SceneNode_DtorDelete already exists at 0x00577740, so this copy keeps maybe_ to avoid a duplicate name; the class is supported by vtable row 0x0075FEDC sitting next to the confident Gfx_Node_Dtor and Gfx_SceneNode_EnsureChildObjectB, and the callee 0x005F8528 lies inside the confident Field_SceneObject_Delete.
